blob_split — BLOB split op

• Data kinds: labels2d × labels2d × image2d → labels2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.blob_split(labels: 'Any', seeds: 'Any', distance: 'Any') -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import blob2d; blob2d.blob_split(labels: 'Any', seeds: 'Any', distance: 'Any') -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsblob.get("blob_split"))

Usage

Grows regions from the seeds in order from the highest points and splits merged clumps (watershed).

Starting from the pixels with the highest distance, each absorbs an adjacent known label (immersion-type watershed run in descending order of distance). Clumps without a seed are kept as they are -- deleting them when there is nothing to split them with would be a lie.

segmentation.watersheds_marker is not used because in an environment without skimage it silently falls back to a different algorithm (nearest neighbour from the markers). That fallback never looks at the image at all, so the same function name returns something different. This one is closed under numpy and scipy alone.

Parameters

labels : array_like

What to split. Output of blob_label (only pixels > 0 are split).

seeds : array_like

Output of blob_seeds. Seeds outside labels are ignored.

distance : array_like

Priority. Usually the output of blob_distance.

Returns

numpy.ndarray

int32 label image. Numbers are reassigned from 1.
